title: MapleStory Familiar System Guide
author: Nexon MapleStory Support
summary: The official end-to-end Familiar reference covering cards, collection slots, summoning, gauge management, levels, ranks, potentials, badges, extraction, and the Familiar Shop.

sections.title: Collect and summon
items: Use Familiar Cards to add entries to the collection.
Assign familiars in Setup and use the Summon Familiar skill to activate their bonuses.

sections.title: Grow and rank
items: Summoned familiars gain EXP and levels from defeated monsters.
Fusion supplies Rank Up points, while successful rank-ups reset level and reroll potentials.

sections.title: Badges, extraction, and shop
items: Complete sets to earn badges and unlock additional summon slots.
Extract unwanted familiars for points and spend them in the Familiar Shop.

notes: Official support article verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Add Familiar Cards to the collection.
Extract only unwanted copies after reviewing the irreversible result.
